lines.en: Hello, friends! Let's sing, count, and learn with five little monkeys!
lines.zh: 小朋友们好！一起和五只小猴子唱歌、数数、学英语吧！

lines.en: Five little monkeys jump, jump, jump on the bed!
lines.zh: 五只小猴子，在床上跳呀跳呀跳！

lines.en: One slipped off... bonk! And bumped a head.
lines.zh: 一只滑下来……咚！撞到了头。

lines.en: Mama monkey called the doctor. Ring, ring!
lines.zh: 猴妈妈给医生打电话。叮铃铃！

lines.en: The doctor said: Beds are for sleeping, not for jumping!
lines.zh: 医生说：床是用来睡觉的，不是用来跳的！

lines.en: Five take away one makes four. 5 minus 1 equals 4!
lines.zh: 5 减 1 等于 4！还剩四只小猴子。

lines.en: Word time! monkey. Say it with me: monkey!
lines.zh: 学单词：monkey，猴子！跟我一起说：monkey！

lines.en: Four little monkeys jump, jump, jump on the bed!
lines.zh: 四只小猴子，在床上跳呀跳呀跳！

lines.en: One slipped off... bonk! And bumped a head.
lines.zh: 一只滑下来……咚！撞到了头。

lines.en: Mama monkey called the doctor. Ring, ring!
lines.zh: 猴妈妈给医生打电话。叮铃铃！

lines.en: The doctor said: Beds are for sleeping, not for jumping!
lines.zh: 医生说：床是用来睡觉的，不是用来跳的！

lines.en: Four take away one makes three. 4 minus 1 equals 3!
lines.zh: 4 减 1 等于 3！还剩三只小猴子。

lines.en: Word time! bed. Say it with me: bed!
lines.zh: 学单词：bed，床！跟我一起说：bed！

lines.en: Three little monkeys jump, jump, jump on the bed!
lines.zh: 三只小猴子，在床上跳呀跳呀跳！

lines.en: One slipped off... bonk! And bumped a head.
lines.zh: 一只滑下来……咚！撞到了头。

lines.en: Mama monkey called the doctor. Ring, ring!
lines.zh: 猴妈妈给医生打电话。叮铃铃！

lines.en: The doctor said: Beds are for sleeping, not for jumping!
lines.zh: 医生说：床是用来睡觉的，不是用来跳的！

lines.en: Three take away one makes two. 3 minus 1 equals 2!
lines.zh: 3 减 1 等于 2！还剩二只小猴子。

lines.en: Word time! jump. Say it with me: jump!
lines.zh: 学单词：jump，跳！跟我一起说：jump！

lines.en: Two little monkeys jump, jump, jump on the bed!
lines.zh: 二只小猴子，在床上跳呀跳呀跳！

lines.en: One slipped off... bonk! And bumped a head.
lines.zh: 一只滑下来……咚！撞到了头。

lines.en: Mama monkey called the doctor. Ring, ring!
lines.zh: 猴妈妈给医生打电话。叮铃铃！

lines.en: The doctor said: Beds are for sleeping, not for jumping!
lines.zh: 医生说：床是用来睡觉的，不是用来跳的！

lines.en: Two take away one makes one. 2 minus 1 equals 1!
lines.zh: 2 减 1 等于 1！还剩一只小猴子。

lines.en: Word time! head. Say it with me: head!
lines.zh: 学单词：head，头！跟我一起说：head！

lines.en: One little monkey jumps, jumps, jumps on the bed!
lines.zh: 一只小猴子，在床上跳呀跳呀跳！

lines.en: Oh no, it slipped off... bonk! And bumped a head.
lines.zh: 哎呀，它也滑下来……咚！撞到了头。

lines.en: Mama monkey called the doctor. Ring, ring!
lines.zh: 猴妈妈给医生打电话。叮铃铃！

lines.en: The doctor said: Beds are for sleeping, not for jumping!
lines.zh: 医生说：床是用来睡觉的，不是用来跳的！

lines.en: One take away one makes zero. No monkeys on the bed!
lines.zh: 1 减 1 等于 0！床上没有小猴子啦。

lines.en: Word time! doctor. Say it with me: doctor!
lines.zh: 学单词：doctor，医生！跟我一起说：doctor！

lines.en: Now every little monkey is tucked in bed. Shh... good night!
lines.zh: 现在所有的小猴子都乖乖躺在床上啦。嘘……晚安！

lines.en: Let's count down together: five, four, three, two, one, zero!
lines.zh: 我们一起倒数：五、四、三、二、一、零！

lines.en: Monkey, bed, jump, head, doctor. You did it! Great job!
lines.zh: 猴子、床、跳、头、医生。你真棒！
